newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Designer of Russia's PS jet engine dies.
newsitem.headline: Designer of Russia's PS jet engine dies.

text.p: The man who designed Russia's most widely used aircraft engine, Pavel Solovyov, died on Sunday in the northern town of Perm, an aviation official said on Monday.
Solovyov, 79, designed the "PS" engine which powers two-thirds of Russia's civil and military aircraft, a spokesman for the Aviadvigatel design bureau said.
Solovyov headed Aviadvigatel for more than 30 years, but retired a few years ago and became an adviser on design.
His engine powers Russian aircraft including the Tupolev-134, Tu-154, Ilyushin-62, Il-76 and Il-96-300.
Russian airlines have criticised his most advanced engine, the PS-90, saying it needed too much maintenance.
